brief: Goldman's mid-day US equities color, 22 Sep. Index dispersion is the theme: SPX flat, NDX +38bps to new highs on AI strength, Dow -50bps on Financials weakness. AAPL, MU, NVDA led the day's upside, MSFT, AMZN, JPM led the downside. Iran headlines lift crude modestly, still under $100: a report says Iran offered to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within 7 days if the US eases military pressure, and Saudi restarted its East-West pipeline. Trump said at the UN that a US/Iran deal isn't expected until after the midterms. Agentic AI, extended by META's Muse launch, remains the dominant trade: semis, memory and big tech mostly higher, GOOGL expected to launch Gemini 4.0 within weeks, catalysts ahead include Meta Connect, OpenAI Dev Day and MU earnings. The trade's short leg is active too: the Consumer Inertia basket has 45 of 55 names lower, software and AI-exposed Financials, Insurance and consumer names are also down. Desk flow is subdued at 3 of 10. Both LOs and HFs are net sellers today. Hedge fund Mag7 exposure is near a 3-year 95th percentile, about 20% versus a 14% June trough, three months into the rally off June lows.
